pattern.description: Rows of the My Leads table appear to shift a few pixels sideways and settle back into alignment one after another, top to bottom, while the page chrome stays still.
pattern.why_premium: A subtle row-by-row wave draws the eye down the lead list as the narration says the agent works leads, adding life to a static CRM screen without a camera move.

build_hint.gsap: gsap.fromTo('.lead-row', {x: 12}, {x: 0, duration: 0.3, ease: 'power2.out', stagger: 0.15}) top to bottom; no opacity change.
build_hint.remotion: Per row i: translateX = interpolate(spring({frame: frame - i*4, fps, config: {damping: 200}}), [0, 1], [12, 0]); rows already visible.

notes: Motion is very small (low energy, camera none) and only readable at thumbnail scale; the filmstrip suggests rows offset horizontally in sequence (rows 1-3 early, 5-6 later) then realign. Direction and whether it is a deliberate stagger or a screen-recording reflow need a human look. b01 union and header diff boxes (b03-b12) show only faint change and are not listed.
